verdict.rationale: SumUp has no built-in rules engine. The only event mechanism documented is a webhook for checkout status changes, set via a `return_url` at checkout creation, so the user has to write their own code to turn that event into automated actions. The pricing page mentions 'automated marketing', but nothing shows user-defined rules. Missing for 10: a native rule or trigger configuration, event types beyond checkout status, and documentation of acting on events automatically without custom code.
